title: From Village to Virtual
script: Some of us grew up where NEPA no sure, where network dey do hide and seek, where phone na luxury. Today? We dey build apps. We dey record podcasts. We dey create AI tools for the same continent we love. Never be ashamed of your 'before' – na that story go make your 'after' sweet. From village to virtual, African excellence no get limit!
caption:
From village to virtual – every step of the journey matters. 🌍✨

Some of us grew up where generator was luxury. Now we building apps and AI tools.

If your journey started from 'no light, no network' type '🌟 ME TOO 🌟' below!

Never be ashamed of your 'before' – na part of your story! 💛
